WildFaces’ No Deep Learning “intuitive AI” can ensure successful AI adoption in the Maintenance space as it requires less than 30 images of components in good condition for training each component model. column1: Self-developed high-throughput network adapter FLEXFLOW®-2200T,Self-developed high-throughput network adapter FLEXFLOW®-2200T,"The FLEXFLOW®-2200T is a general-purpose network interface card (NIC) product developed by Zhongke Yushu based on their self-developed K2-Pro chip. It supports dual 100G network connectivity at its highest configuration. The product features SR-IOV hardware virtualization technology and provides comprehensive kernel and user-space driver support, making it suitable for a wide range of customer scenarios including cloud computing, internet services, finance, telecommunications, government, and enterprise environments.
column2: 【 APPLICATION SCENARIOS 】
column3: Cloud computing virtualization scenarios
column4: Under traditional pure software virtualization methods, resource utilization tends to be low. To ensure high-performance network data processing requirements, it is necessary to avoid mutual interference between virtual machines. As a result, a single physical machine usually does not run multiple critical applications. The FLEXFLOW-2200T general-purpose network card supports SR-IOV hardware virtualization, which can dynamically provide a large number of hardware network interfaces. Through the VF (Virtual Function) direct pass-through mode to virtual machines, it can offer I/O performance comparable to bare-metal environments. Therefore, it can improve the network throughput of individual virtual machines, thus enhancing the utilization of computational resources.
column5: Data center business high availability scenario
column6: In the data center scenario, to avoid the impact of communication link failures on business systems, a robust high-availability mechanism is required to handle potential issues. The FLEXFLOW-2200T general-purpose network card comprehensively supports link redundancy backup and load balancing functions under the Linux system. While achieving high-performance data transmission, it also provides a high level of reliability and availability. In the event of a failure, it can automatically switch links to ensure that user services remain uninterrupted.
column7: High-throughput scenario for distributed storage
column8: The deployment architecture of distributed storage systems is relatively simple, with servers typically interconnected via TCP/IP networks. As storage technologies continue to evolve, the demand for higher bandwidth and lower latency in storage networks is increasing, making traditional 10/25Gbps networks a bottleneck for system performance improvement. column11: Under traditional pure software virtualization methods, resource utilization tends to be low. Through the VF (Virtual Function) direct pass-through mode to virtual machines, it can offer I/O performance comparable to bare-metal environments. Therefore, it can improve the network throughput of individual virtual machines, thus enhancing the utilization of computational resources.

column1: Libpet Power,Libpet Power,"Libpet Power is an all-terrain power wheelchair with special features of stair-climbing and anti-collision.  It serves as a personal vehicle, enabling users to navigate sandy land, grassland, staircases and other uneven surfaces.  Users of the Libpet Power can enjoy the freedom of mobility that would otherwise be impossible due to the lack of suitable facilities and passageways. The ultra-sonic anti-collision system will keep you safer during reverse movement.  It can climb staircases with a gradient up to 36° . It can overcome obstacles and gaps of up to 20cm. The maximum driving range can be as far as 36km with a capacity load of 100kg. Many of the rest parts are designed to be adjustable, such as the armrest, backrest and footrest, in order to fit different body conditions. It is powered by a Lithium-ion battery that can be detached for convenient charging and maintenance. The navigation is controlled by a dedicated control panel, enabling instant and responsive response. In addition, a dedicated mobile app has been developed for users to control the wheelchair remotely. The app allow users to adjust speed, direction, and access location-based information. column3: In conclusion, the Libpet Power is a masterpiece of refined art and meticulous engineering. column1: Libpet Mini,Libpet Mini,"The Libpet Mini is an intelligent mobility device equipped with special features such as anti-collision technology and a compact size.
